thread:
Anna: Just uploaded v3 of the suppression-preview + compact thresholds mock. Figured we could iterate on copy + keyboard flow. https://figma.com/file/abcd1234 :eyes:
Mike: Nice — looks denser which is good for power users. Quick copy q: we currently show 'Silence for 1h' vs 'Suppress for 1h' in different places. Prefer one term?
Anna: Good catch. I used 'Silence' in the notification panel earlier, but 'Suppress' in the SLO modal. We should pick one. Thoughts?
Lina: From an engineering POV "silence" implies muting notifications, "suppress" implies preventing alerts. People will expect different behaviour. Maybe use "Mute notifications" (explicit) in UI and keep "Suppress" for rule-level config?
Kai: Accessibility note: the compact pill focus ring is near-invisible at 2px inner shadow. Keyboard tab order also jumps past the "preview channels" button. We need an ARIA label and visible focus for 3:1 contrast.
Anna: Thanks Kai — can you suggest exact aria? I tried: aria-label="Notification channel preview, opens a popover". Too verbose?
Kai: That's fine. For shorter text use aria-label="Preview channels" and add aria-describedby to include more context for screen readers. Also adjust focus outline color to #005b9f for WCAG 3:1 on our background.
Sam: Copy tweak idea: instead of 'Temporarily silence' maybe 'Mute for 1 hour' — more conversational and action-oriented.
Mike: +1 for 'Mute for 1 hour'. Also, can we add a microcopy under the pill: 'Applies to this policy only' — helps prevent accidental org-wide assumptions.
Anna: Good microcopy suggestion. Where would that live on mobile? Space is tight. Could be a flyout or an info tooltip.
Lina: Tooltip is fine, but tooltips are inaccessible on touch. If we add an inline small caption (12px) it stays discoverable. Use visually small text and link to details page.
design-bot: Reminder: component tokens team updated button-focus token last week. See #eng-design-tokens thread.
Anna: OK — I'll update the mock: change label to 'Mute for 1 hour', add caption 'Applies to this policy only', swap pill focus color to #005b9f, add aria-label 'Preview channels'.
Mike: One more UX ask — when a channel name is truncated we should show full name on hover + accessible tooltip. Long channel names break the preview grid right now.
Anna: Noted. I'll add ellipsis with title attribute and role=tooltip on hover states.
Kai: For keyboard users, ensure the tooltip is triggered by focus too (onfocus=showTooltip). Also ensure role=tooltip and aria-hidden toggles appropriately.
Sam: LGTM. Small nit: change the suppression toggle to a switch control pattern (so it's consistent with other boolean controls).
Anna: Good point. I'll swap the pill to a switch in the next iteration and push updated frames by EOD. :thumbsup:
Lina: If you can, add an example sentence in the caption: 'Muted alerts won't generate notifications but will appear in the incidents list.' Helps set expectations.
Anna: Will do. Thanks everyone — pushing update now.
Mike: Thanks — will review once pushed. :eyes:
